description: She wears an opaque deep red fitted court gown with a low square neckline, gold-and-cream woven borders at the neckline, elbow-length cuffs, front opening and floor-length hem. A pale cream underdress shows through the central skirt opening. A dark blue wrap edged in matching gold-patterned trim rests around her forearms. A belt of round metal plaques and a hanging central chain sit at the waist; a small round pendant hangs at the chest. Brown leather footwear is visible below the skirt, with the second foot mostly concealed by fabric. Both hands meet naturally in front of the waist. The stone doorway behind her is plain and has no banners or heraldry.
